comment: if jynx replies make the reply from its own user and not admin, i love when jynx replys and its great it can answer to replyies or start random conversations even here and there maybe say great idea! or nice, or even funny things, but make it have its own user so well know its jynx and not admin user
actionLog: Implemented the concrete, inferable half of this request: an admin-only "Reply as Jynx" toggle on any reply thread (QA-annotation or Jynx-feedback), so a reply can be attributed to a distinct "Jynx" identity (Sparkles badge, no clickable profile link, since there's no real user behind it) instead of the admin's own real name. Server-side enforced (only an actually-admin-authenticated caller can trigger it) so a regular dev user can't spoof the identity. Deliberately did NOT build the other half of the comment (Jynx autonomously deciding to reply / start conversations / write playful text on its own) — that's a real product/architecture decision (trigger conditions, content generation, moderation) that isn't safely inferable from one QA comment, so it was left for a human decision rather than guessed at. See PR #45's "Thinking process" section for the full reasoning.
